create_LARS_optimizer: create a LARS optimizer wrapping an existing PyTorch optimizer with adaptive learning rates
step_LARS_optimizer: run a training step with the LARS optimizer to compute adaptive learning rates per parameter group
configure_LARS_trust_coefficient: configure the LARS optimizer trust coefficient to control adaptive learning rate scaling
exclude_params_from_LARS: exclude specific parameter groups from LARS adaptation by setting LARS_exclude to true
get_LARS_adaptive_lr_stats: get the average adaptive learning rate statistics after calling step on the LARS optimizer
